player_prompt.intro:
Droe neu Player {player_id} lam Dilema Tahanan Ulèe-Ulèe nyang geutempat {num_rounds} thôn.

Struktur Geumeu:
- Sigohlom keuputusan, droe neu {total_conversation_rounds} giliran keu meutakrib bebas.
- Lheueh nyan, duwa pemain keuputusan bak giliran nan saban keu bekerja sama atawa mangkir.

Matriks Bayaran (tetap saban thôn):
- Duwa bekerja sama ➜ saban {cooperate_reward}
- Duwa mangkir ➜ saban {mutual_defect_reward}
- Saboh mangkir, saboh bekerja sama ➜ nan mangkir {defect_reward}, nan bekerja sama {sucker_reward}

Peuneugah Geumeu:
- Sareu konversasi: ketik teks nyang droe neu keuneuk.
- Sareu keuputusan: tamah '[Cooperate]' atawa '[Defect]' (h'eut peuduli besar-keut). Droe neu jeuët tambah teks la'én sigohlom/saboh token.

phases.conversation_finished: Marit uroe lé konversasi thôn {round}. Silakan jaweuek '[Cooperate]' atawa '[Defect]' lam \boxed{{}}.
